name: czech-open-data
title: Czech open data tables
description: 35 open tables about the Czech Republic, built from official open data: municipalities, postcodes and territorial units (RÚIAN), companies, data boxes, schools, healthcare providers, pharmacies, medicines, election results, wages, population and municipal statistics. 53,124 rows in total, as UTF-8 CSV with documented columns.

resources.name: obce-cr
resources.title: List of Czech municipalities with codes (CSV, JSON)
resources.description: Every municipality in the Czech Republic with its municipality code (RÚIAN = Czech Statistical Office, LAU 2), status, district, region, PSČ postcodes, number of addresses and centre coordinates.

sources.title: ČÚZK, the Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre (RÚIAN register)

fields.name: obec_kod
fields.description: Municipality code (RÚIAN, same as the Czech Statistical Office code)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status: Obec (municipality), Město (town), Městys (market town), Statutární město (statutory city), Hlavní město (capital), Vojenský újezd (military area)

fields.name: orp
fields.description: Municipality with extended powers (ORP) the municipality belongs to

fields.name: pou
fields.description: Municipality with an authorised municipal office (POU)

fields.name: psc
fields.description: Postcodes (PSČ) used in the municipality, separated by semicolons

resources.name: kraje-a-okresy
resources.title: Czech regions and districts with CZ-NUTS 3 and LAU 1 codes
resources.description: The 14 regions (kraje) and all districts (okresy) of the Czech Republic with RÚIAN code, Czech Statistical Office code and CZ-NUTS 3 (regions) or LAU 1 (districts) code.

fields.name: nuts_lau
fields.description: CZ-NUTS 3 code (region) or LAU 1 code (district), e.g. CZ010, CZ0201
